irreducibility_argument: A reducible monic quartic over F3 has a linear factor or two irreducible quadratics. No F3 root and no irreducible quadratic divisor excludes both; reduction preserves degree, proving irreducible over Q. Its monic rational normalization has constant1/7, so the root is not an algebraic integer.
limitation: Does not show the specialized braid image is nondiscrete; falsifies the printed Salem label only.
